title: DB migration: remote_pin_jobs table in transit DB
description:
What: Add remote_pin_jobs table to track external pinning job state.

Algorithm:
1. Create crates/transit/migrations/20260104000002_remote_pin_jobs.sql:

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS remote_pin_jobs (
    id              INTEGER  PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    cid             TEXT     NOT NULL,
    service_name    TEXT     NOT NULL,
    status          TEXT     NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    request_id      TEXT,           -- service-assigned ID from POST /pins response
    submitted_at_ms INTEGER,        -- when POST /pins was sent
    last_attempt_ms INTEGER,        -- when status was last checked
    attempt_count   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    error           TEXT            -- last error message if failed
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rpj_status ON remote_pin_jobs (status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rpj_cid ON remote_pin_jobs (cid);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rpj_cid_service ON remote_pin_jobs (cid, service_name);

Status values: 'pending' (not yet submitted), 'queued' (submitted, waiting), 'pinning' (in progress), 'pinned' (done), 'failed' (permanent failure after max attempts)

2. Register migration in transit migration runner (follow existing pattern in crates/transit/src/migrations.rs or wherever migrations are run for the transit pool)

Defensive programming:
- UNIQUE index on (cid, service_name) prevents duplicate jobs
- status DEFAULT 'pending' makes insertion simple
- request_id is NULL until service responds to POST /pins
